Hobo: Ugh…{{wi}} Guys. I think we went a little too far.
???: Just throw him into a dumpster.
Hobo: Good idea!
Hobo: {{punch}}Not this one! Idiot! The corpse will start rotting at some point! Do you want a rotting corpse in your alleyway?! 
Hobo: Put him in a cart and move somewhere else and then hide the body in a dumpster! Ok?
Hobo: Shit. His brain-juice-thingy stained the sidewalk. This is the worst. Does anyone have any wipes? The wet ones would be the best.
I guess…{{wi}} It wasn’t such a good idea…
